label: Power Management (Issue #10)
info:
Battery / 5 V rail meter, power-mode toggle (Active / Sleep / Emergency Shutdown) and relay load view for the Water Rover v2 power manager.

MQTT topics:
- rover/power/status (in)  JSON from the ESP32
- rover/power/cmd (out)    active | sleep | emergency | reset
- rover/power/req/1..4 (out) 1 | 0  load requests

No hardware? Switch on 'Simulate ESP32' on the dashboard.
